#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

import time
import signal
import sys

running = True

def signal_handler(signum, frame):
    global running
    print("\n收到中断信号，倒计时停止。")
    running = False

signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal_handler)
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal_handler)

def main():
    global running
    try:
        seconds = int(input("请输入倒计时秒数："))
        if seconds < 0:
            print("秒数必须大于等于 0。")
            return
    except ValueError:
        print("输入无效，请输入整数。")
        return

    print(f"开始倒计时：{seconds} 秒...")
    
    while running and seconds > 0:
        print(f"\r剩余时间：{seconds} 秒", end="", flush=True)
        time.sleep(1)
        seconds -= 1
    
    if running:
        print("\n倒计时结束！")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

import time
import signal
import sys

running = True

def signal_handler(signum, frame):
    global running
    print("\n收到中断信号，倒计时停止。")
    running = False

signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal_handler)
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal_handler)

def main():
    global running
    try:
        seconds = int(input("请输入倒计时秒数："))
        if seconds < 0:
            print("秒数必须大于等于 0。")
            return
    except ValueError:
        print("输入无效，请输入整数。")
        return

    print(f"开始倒计时：{seconds} 秒...")
    
    while running and seconds > 0:
        print(f"\r剩余时间：{seconds} 秒", end="", flush=True)
        time.sleep(1)
        seconds -= 1
    
    if running:
        print("\n倒计时结束！")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

  run_cmd  cmd、timeout  ——  在工作目录里跑一条命令，回它的输出和退出码。例如 cmd="python main.py"
